note: Motivation library for Bastion. Scriptures are WEB (public domain). Reframes, urge_lines, affirmations and prayers are original (Bastion). Quotes carry a `verified` flag: items whose attribution is unsourced or known to belong to someone else are marked false and are never shown — see ContentRepository.motivationFor. A misattributed line undermines the one thing this app is selling.

items.text: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

Flee sexual immorality! ... Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own, for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body.
I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.
I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.
Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.
Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.
But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won't fulfill the lust of the flesh.
Don't be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind.
Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me.
Don't be afraid, for I am with you. Don't be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you.
It is because of Yahweh's loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his compassion doesn't fail. They are new every morning; great is your faithfulness.
Don't rejoice against me, my enemy. When I fall, I will arise. When I sit in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to me.
For a righteous man falls seven times, and rises up again; but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.
For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
Let's lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let's run with perseverance the race that is set before us.
There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus.
Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.
Let's not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don't give up.
Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.
I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from? My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire.
He has said to me, "My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness."
Blessed is the man who doesn't walk in the counsel of the wicked ... but his delight is in Yahweh's law. He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water.
But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary.
If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.
Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts. See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.
Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don't lean on your own understanding. In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.
Watch and pray, that you don't enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.
For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality, that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
Haven't I commanded you? Be strong and courageous. Don't be afraid. Don't be dismayed, for Yahweh your God is with you wherever you go.

For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men, instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
The happiness of your life depends upon the quality of your thoughts.
If it is not right, do not do it, if it is not true, do not say it.
Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
The impediment to action advances action. What stands in the way becomes the way.
You could leave life right now. Let that determine what you do and say and think.
Confine yourself to the present.
We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
It is not that we have a short time to live, but that we waste much of it.
Most powerful is he who has himself in his own power.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
No man is free who is not master of himself.
It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
First say to yourself what you would be; and then do what you have to do.
No great thing is created suddenly.
Man conquers the world by conquering himself.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
Knowing yourself is the beginning of all wisdom.
The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
Our greatest glory is not in never falling, but in rising every time we fall.
The successful warrior is the average man, with laser-like focus.
Do not pray for an easy life, pray for the strength to endure a difficult one.
Discipline is choosing between what you want now and what you want most.
Whether you think you can, or you think you can't — you're right.
The best way out is always through.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
Nothing can bring you peace but yourself.
Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
If one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams... he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
I am not what happened to me, I am what I choose to become.
Freedom is not worth having if it does not include the freedom to make mistakes.
Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
A hero is no braver than an ordinary man, but he is brave five minutes longer.
Character cannot be developed in ease and quiet. Only through experience of trial and suffering can the soul be strengthened.
I would rather die a meaningful death than to live a meaningless life.
He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
That which does not kill us makes us stronger.
The only way out of the labyrinth of suffering is to forgive.
Success is to be measured not so much by the position that one has reached in life as by the obstacles which he has overcome.
If there is no struggle, there is no progress.
I prefer to be true to myself, even at the hazard of incurring the ridicule of others.
The chains of habit are too weak to be felt until they are too strong to be broken.
Great works are performed not by strength but by perseverance.
He who conquers himself is the mightiest warrior.
Courage is resistance to fear, mastery of fear — not absence of fear.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
Twenty years from now you will be more disappointed by the things that you didn't do than by the ones you did do.
Fall seven times, stand up eight.
The gem cannot be polished without friction, nor a man perfected without trials.
Watch your thoughts, they become words; watch your words, they become actions; watch your actions, they become habits; watch your habits, they become character.
A man who conquers himself is greater than one who conquers a thousand men in battle.
Do not spoil what you have by desiring what you have not.
Rule your desires lest your desires rule you.
The wise man is not he who has the most, but he who needs the least.
Patience and perseverance have a magical effect before which difficulties disappear and obstacles vanish.
An urge is a wave. It rises, it peaks, and — if you don't feed it — it falls. You have never once been destroyed by a wave you didn't ride. Wait ninety seconds.
The craving is not you asking for this. It's an old circuit asking for a hit. You are the one who gets to say no.
You will not die from wanting something and not getting it. You'll just be a stronger man in five minutes.
This feeling is loud, but it is not in charge. Loud is not the same as strong.
The version of you that you want to be is deciding right now, in this exact moment. Vote for him.
Relapse is a data point, not a verdict. Log it, learn the trigger, keep the rank you built.
Shame says 'you are bad, so hide.' Growth says 'you slipped, so learn.' One keeps the cycle turning; the other breaks it.
You didn't lose everything. You lost a streak. The man you've become across all these weeks is still standing here.
Every clean night is a deposit. You are building someone. Don't withdraw it for ninety seconds of nothing.
Boredom is not an emergency. It's just an empty room. You don't have to fill it with this.
Loneliness wants connection, not a screen. The screen will leave you lonelier. Call someone. Go outside.
The dopamine spike is a loan with brutal interest. You feel it for minutes and pay it back for days.
Your future wife, your future kids, the man in the mirror in ten years — they are all downstream of what you do tonight.
Discipline is just self-respect with a plan.
You are not resisting pleasure. You are choosing a better one — clarity, confidence, self-trust.
The phone feels like the answer because it's within reach. Reach further. Reach for the man you're building.
Motivation is a mood; discipline is a decision. You don't need to feel like it. You just need to not do it.
Nobody ever regretted going to bed clean. Not once, not ever.
The urge is lying about how big it is. In an hour you won't even remember it was here.
You've said no before. You are literally the kind of man who can do this. You have proof.
Comparison on a feed is a rigged game — their highlight reel against your behind-the-scenes. Put it down.
Tired is when the old pattern comes hunting, because it knows your guard is down. Name it, and it loses half its power.
You can be gentle with yourself and still not give in. Grace and a spine are not opposites.
The goal was never a perfect streak. The goal is a free man. Free men fall and get up.
What you feed grows. What you starve dies. Starve it one more night.
You are not missing out on anything real. You are opting out of a trap.
Every time you hold the line, the next time gets easier. You're not just resisting — you're rewiring.
The man you admire didn't feel like it either. He just did the next right thing anyway.
Anger is looking for a release valve. This isn't it — it's a trapdoor. Move your body instead.
Alone at home is where this feels safe. That's the lie. The best version of you is watching too.
Not tonight. Not this. Breathe.
Ninety seconds. Just outlast it.
You are stronger than this moment.
Get up. Move. Change the room.
This wave will pass. Ride it out.
Future you is begging you to stop. Listen.
One clean night. That's all this is.
You've beaten this before. Beat it again.
Put the phone down and walk away.
Hold the line. The rest of you is worth it.
This is the moment that makes the man.
Cold water. Twenty push-ups. Now.
The urge is loud. You are in charge.
Don't trade who you're becoming for this.
Call your partner. Don't do this alone.
You will be so proud of this in an hour.
It's not real hunger. Let it pass.
Stand up. This ends standing up.
You are not your urges. Prove it.
Close the door on it. Keep your streak.
God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, the courage to change the things I can, and the wisdom to know the difference.
Father, I am weak right now, but You are strong. Be my strength in this exact moment. Make the way of escape and help me take it.
Lord, create in me a clean heart. I don't want this. I want You. Renew my mind tonight.
God, I fell. I'm not hiding. Thank You that there is no condemnation in Christ. Pick me up and let me keep walking.
Father, guard my eyes and my heart tonight. Where I am weak, be my wall.
Lord, I am lonely, and I was reaching for the wrong thing. Meet me here. Remind me I am not alone.
Jesus, thank You that I am a new creation. Help me live tonight like the man You've already made me.
Holy Spirit, I give You this craving. It is too big for me and too small for You. Carry me through the next ten minutes.
Father, thank You that Your mercies are new every morning. Tomorrow I begin again, held by grace.
Lord, make me a man of my word — first to You, then to myself. Let my yes be yes and my no be no.
I am becoming a man I can respect.
I keep my word to myself.
I am free, and I am building on that freedom.
My discipline is a gift to the people I love.
I do not have to act on every feeling.
I am stronger than my urges, and I have proof.
I choose clarity over the spike.
I am the guardian of my own eyes.
Every clean day makes me more myself.
I fall, I rise, I keep walking.
I am not my worst night.
I am worthy of the life I'm building.
I meet boredom without flinching.
I am calm, and calm is strong.
I protect my future family tonight.
I am present, awake, and in control.
I do the next right thing.
My no is a full sentence.
I am loved, and I don't need this.
I am the man my future self is counting on.

An old man told his grandson: 'A battle rages inside me between two wolves. One is anger, envy, lust, and shame. The other is peace, discipline, love, and hope.' The boy asked, 'Which one wins?' The old man answered, 'The one you feed.' Tonight, you choose which wolf eats.
items.title: The Two Wolves

items.text: A man decided to build a wall, one brick a day. On any given day the wall looked no different than the day before, and he was tempted to skip — what difference could one brick make? But he laid it anyway, every day. A year later he stood behind a wall taller than himself. Your streak is a wall. Lay tonight's brick.
items.title: The Compound Wall

items.text: A young archer wept after missing the target, ready to throw down his bow forever. His master picked up the arrow, handed it back, and said only: 'The master has failed more times than the beginner has even tried. Draw again.' A slip is not the end of your training. It is the training. Draw again.
items.title: The Archer's Miss

items.text: A sailor learned that the worst of any storm passes in minutes if you simply hold the wheel and don't panic. Urges are the same. Neuroscientists will tell you the peak of a craving lasts only a few minutes. You are not being asked to resist forever. You are being asked to hold the wheel for ninety seconds. You can do ninety seconds.
items.title: Ninety Seconds

items.text: A man kept a room in his house he swore he'd never enter, yet he left the key on the hook by the door where his hand fell every night. One day he gave the key to a friend. He didn't become stronger overnight — he just made the weak moment cost more than it was worth. That is what these guards are. Not a cage. A key, handed to a friend.
items.title: The Locked Room

items.text: A son wasted everything and sat in the mud, certain he'd burned every bridge, rehearsing his apology. But while he was still a long way off, his father saw him, ran to him, and threw a robe over his shoulders before a word was spoken. If you fell tonight, the walk home is shorter than shame tells you. You are not walking toward a judge. You are walking toward a Father who is already running.
items.title: The Prodigal's Walk Home

items.text: Iron does not become a blade in comfort. It is heated until it glows, then hammered, then plunged into cold water, then heated again. Every trial you are enduring is the forge. The discomfort you feel tonight is not damage. It is tempering. You are being made into something that holds an edge.
items.title: The Blacksmith

items.text: A man noticed he only reached for the old habit when he was bored, tired, or alone — never when his life was full. So he stopped fighting the habit head-on and started filling the room instead: a barbell, a Bible, a friend on speed-dial, a cold shower. The habit didn't need to be defeated. It needed to be crowded out. Fill the room.
items.title: The Empty Room

items.text: The intense peak of a craving typically lasts only a few minutes before it subsides on its own — you rarely have to outlast it for long.
Urges tend to lose power the more times you don't act on them. Each refusal makes the next one easier. You are rewiring, not just resisting.
Naming an emotion — 'this is loneliness,' 'this is boredom' — measurably reduces its intensity. Label the feeling and it loosens its grip.
Physical movement changes your brain state fast. Twenty push-ups or a walk outside can end a craving that willpower alone couldn't.
Sleep debt is one of the most reliable predictors of a slip. Guarding your bedtime guards more than your mornings.
Most people massively overestimate how bad they'll feel if they don't act on an urge, and underestimate how good they'll feel for holding the line.
Accountability is one of the strongest predictors of sticking to a hard change. You are not weak for needing a partner — you're smart.
Willpower works less like a muscle you run out of and more like a skill you build. Every rep tonight makes tomorrow's rep easier.
To handle yourself, use your head; to handle others, use your heart.
What we call our destiny is truly our character, and that character can be altered.
Life shrinks or expands in proportion to one's courage.
I am very happy because I have conquered myself and not the world.
Self-control is the chief element in self-respect, and self-respect is the chief element in courage.
Ultimately, the only power to which man should aspire is that which he exercises over himself.
The ability to subordinate an impulse to a value is the essence of the proactive person.
items.source: The 7 Habits of Highly Effective People

items.text: He who cannot obey himself will be commanded.
The enemy is within the gates; it is with our own luxury, our own folly, our own criminality that we have to contend.
Not being able to govern events, I govern myself.
The intelligent desire self-control; children want candy.
Everybody in the world is seeking happiness, and there is one sure way to find it. That is by controlling your thoughts.
True freedom is impossible without a mind made free by discipline.
Self-respect is the root of discipline: the sense of dignity grows with the ability to say no to oneself.
You will never have a greater or lesser dominion than that over yourself.
Discipline yourself, and others won't need to.
Be more concerned with your character than your reputation, because your character is what you really are.
A disciplined mind leads to happiness, and an undisciplined mind leads to suffering.
Discipline teaches us to operate by principle rather than desire.
You may encounter many defeats, but you must not be defeated.
Sometimes even to live is an act of courage.
I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.
Always bear in mind that your own resolution to succeed is more important than any other one thing.
Many of life's failures are people who did not realize how close they were to success when they gave up.
Never confuse a single defeat with a final defeat.
Dripping water hollows out stone, not through force but through persistence.
If you fell down yesterday, stand up today.
The difference between a successful person and others is not a lack of strength, not a lack of knowledge, but rather a lack of will.
Go back? No good at all! Go sideways? Impossible! Go forward? Only thing to do!
Courage is found in unlikely places.
Let me not pray to be sheltered from dangers, but to be fearless in facing them.
Even if I knew that tomorrow the world would go to pieces, I would still plant my apple tree.
Never, never, never give in.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
I learned that courage was not the absence of fear, but the triumph over it. The brave man is not he who does not feel afraid, but he who conquers that fear.
Courage is the most important of all the virtues, because without courage you can't practice any other virtue consistently.
It takes courage to grow up and become who you really are.
Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.
You cannot swim for new horizons until you have courage to lose sight of the shore.
A ship is safe in harbor, but that's not what ships are for.
All happiness depends on courage and work.
The most courageous act is still to think for yourself. Aloud.
Whoever is careless with the truth in small matters cannot be trusted with important matters.
You can easily judge the character of a man by how he treats those who can do nothing for him.
The greatest thing in this world is not so much where we stand as in what direction we are moving.
The best index to a person's character is how he treats people who can't do him any good, and how he treats people who can't fight back.
All cruelty springs from weakness.
It is better to be alone than in bad company.
Real integrity is doing the right thing, knowing that nobody's going to know whether you did it or not.
A quiet conscience makes one strong.
Nothing is at last sacred but the integrity of your own mind.
When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everyone will respect you.
The purpose of life is not to be happy. It is to be useful, to be honorable, to be compassionate, to have it make some difference that you have lived and lived well.
A nail is driven out by another nail; habit is overcome by habit.
There is no more miserable human being than one in whom nothing is habitual but indecision.
We get into the habit of living before acquiring the habit of thinking.
With time and effort, almost any habit can be reshaped.
Your beliefs become your thoughts, your thoughts become your words, your words become your actions, your actions become your habits, your habits become your values, your values become your destiny.
The old that is strong does not wither; deep roots are not reached by the frost.
In the depth of winter, I finally learned that within me there lay an invincible summer.
The weak can never forgive. Forgiveness is the attribute of the strong.
Worry does not empty tomorrow of its sorrow; it empties today of its strength.
Courage isn't having the strength to go on — it is going on when you don't have strength.
There is nothing noble in being superior to your fellow man; true nobility is being superior to your former self.
Those who cannot change their minds cannot change anything.
Make the most of yourself, for that is all there is of you.
Once we accept our limits, we go beyond them.
The curious paradox is that when I accept myself just as I am, then I can change.
Motivation is what gets you started. Habit is what keeps you going.
There is only one corner of the universe you can be certain of improving, and that's your own self.
Hold fast to dreams, for if dreams die, life is a broken-winged bird that cannot fly.
I still believe, in spite of everything, that people are truly good at heart.
Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
Only when it is dark enough can you see the stars.
The only true wisdom is in knowing you know nothing.
The unexamined life is not worth living.
Any fool can know. The point is to understand.
Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
Turn your wounds into wisdom.
The secret of life is to fall seven times and to get up eight times.
Do one thing every day that scares you.
Nothing in life is to be feared, it is only to be understood.
I must not fear. Fear is the mind-killer.
Never be afraid to trust an unknown future to a known God.
Faith is not the belief that God will do what you want. It is the belief that God will do what is right.
All I have seen teaches me to trust the Creator for all I have not seen.
God will not look you over for medals, degrees or diplomas, but for scars.
If the only prayer you ever say is thank you, that will be enough.
To be a Christian means to forgive the inexcusable, because God has forgiven the inexcusable in you.
There is no gate, no lock, no bolt that you can set upon the freedom of my mind.
Freedom lies in being bold.
I do not care so much what I am to others as I care what I am to myself.
Try not to become a man of success. Rather become a man of value.
It is hard to fail, but it is worse never to have tried to succeed.
People of accomplishment rarely sat back and let things happen to them. They went out and happened to things.
Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
I have been bent and broken, but — I hope — into a better shape.
We are products of our past, but we don't have to be prisoners of it.
When we are no longer able to change a situation, we are challenged to change ourselves.
Everything can be taken from a man but one thing: the last of the human freedoms — to choose one's attitude in any given set of circumstances.
The only way we can live is if we grow. The only way we can grow is if we change.
The future belongs to those who believe in the beauty of their dreams.
Dreams are the touchstones of our characters.
Dare to live the life you have dreamed for yourself.
Hope is a waking dream.
It does not do to dwell on dreams and forget to live.
Forgiveness is not an occasional act, it is a constant attitude.
To err is human; to forgive, divine.
Resentment is like drinking poison and then hoping it will kill your enemies.
To be wronged is nothing, unless you continue to remember it.
And once the storm is over, you won't be the same person who walked in.
The most beautiful people we have known are those who have known defeat, known suffering, known struggle, and have found their way out of the depths.
Nothing in the world is worth having or worth doing unless it means effort, pain, and difficulty.
We must be willing to let go of the life we planned so as to have the life that is waiting for us.
Life doesn't get easier or more forgiving; we get stronger and more resilient.
My scars remind me that I did indeed survive my deepest wounds.
A good half of the art of living is resilience.
Be who you are and say what you feel, because those who mind don't matter and those who matter don't mind.
You gain strength, courage and confidence by every experience in which you really stop to look fear in the face.
You probably wouldn't worry about what people think of you if you could know how seldom they do.
Man often becomes what he believes himself to be.
You have no responsibility to live up to what other people think you ought to accomplish.
No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
Let us be grateful to the people who make us happy; they are the charming gardeners who make our souls blossom.
Gratitude turns what we have into enough.
A man's mind, once stretched by a new idea, never regains its original dimensions.
It is the power of the mind to be unconquerable.
Darkness cannot drive out darkness: only light can do that.
Live as if you were to die tomorrow. Learn as if you were to live forever.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
It is never too late to be what you might have been.
Life isn't about finding yourself. Life is about creating yourself.
Though nobody can go back and make a new beginning, anyone can start over and make a new ending.
It's no use going back to yesterday, because I was a different person then.
If you don't spend your life yourself, other people will spend it for you.
Do what is right, not what is easy nor what is popular.
The past is a place of reference, not a place of residence.
The first and greatest victory is to conquer yourself.
Courage is knowing what not to fear.
Mastering others is strength. Mastering yourself is true power.
When I let go of what I am, I become what I might be.
The man who moves a mountain begins by carrying away small stones.
Patience is bitter, but its fruit is sweet.
Excellence is never an accident; it is the result of high intention, sincere effort, and intelligent execution.
It is during our darkest moments that we must focus to see the light.
What we think, we become.
No one saves us but ourselves. No one can and no one may. We ourselves must walk the path.
The wound is the place where the light enters you.
What you seek is seeking you.
The best revenge is not to be like your enemy.
Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking.
How much more grievous are the consequences of anger than the causes of it.
It is not the man who has too little, but the man who craves more, that is poor.
He who is brave is free.
As is a tale, so is life: not how long it is, but how good it is, is what matters.
Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
He is a wise man who does not grieve for the things he has not, but rejoices for those which he has.
Don't count the days; make the days count.
I hated every minute of training, but I said: don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.
As you think, so shall you become.
Mistakes are always forgivable, if one has the courage to admit them.
Believe you can and you're halfway there.
It always seems impossible until it's done.
Do not judge me by my successes; judge me by how many times I fell down and got back up again.
If you can't fly then run, if you can't run then walk, if you can't walk then crawl, but by all means keep moving.
The time is always right to do what is right.
Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.
A man is but the product of his thoughts. What he thinks, he becomes.
Optimism is the faith that leads to achievement. Nothing can be done without hope and confidence.
With the new day comes new strength and new thoughts.
What you do speaks so loudly that I cannot hear what you say.
The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
Finish each day and be done with it. You have done what you could.
It's not what you look at that matters, it's what you see.
The two most important days in your life are the day you are born and the day you find out why.
Keep away from those who try to belittle your ambitions.
Energy and persistence conquer all things.
Well done is better than well said.
You are never too old to set another goal or to dream a new dream.
Hardships often prepare ordinary people for an extraordinary destiny.
Integrity is doing the right thing, even when no one is watching.
